  # trace_get

  Position selects one traceAddress path: \[] is root, \["0x0"] first child, \["0x6","0x0"] the first child of child six. Return one localized object or null if the transaction/path does not exist. Unavailable state is an error (H02,H06). This is a provisional trace profile; see docs-api/docs/trace-profile.md and its H01-H28 decision references.

  Returns the trace at one tree path.

  **Position** `array<string>` *required*

  hex encoded 64 bit unsigned integer
